import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows (one duplicate present)
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix species label variants (extra spaces / misspelling)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'})
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors within valid range)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix extreme body-mass outlier (likely factor of 1000 error)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('island').size()
    # Drop any missing group keys
    counts = counts.dropna()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
